summary: At synthetic/v50/v50-vrock-flee-cloud-action-attempt1 step 102, monster fear reaches monmove.c:monflee() for a Vrock with mflee clear and mspec_used zero. C sets mspec_used to 75 + rn2(25), calls create_gas_cloud(mx,my,5,8), then sets mflee and clears tracking. The JavaScript monflee() has the branch, but the production adapter in js/unported_monster_actions.js still supplies createGasCloud: () => note_unported("region.c create_gas_cloud"). This skips the existing js/region.js:create_gas_cloud() implementation, its cloud-placement RNG, region/display state, and gas message. The C first unmatched draw is rn2(4)=3 from create_gas_cloud at global RNG index 2946; JavaScript has already advanced to distfleeck’s next rn2(5)=2. GOALS.json contains no whole-source evidence.functions entry for monflee; the earlier v33 adapter task explicitly retained create_gas_cloud as a gap and took no whole-function credit. Implement the complete monmove.c:monflee() source unit and wire its existing production adapter to region.create_gas_cloud, preserving planning/live state, cloud RNG and message order.
